{"step":2,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_incoming_line","line":522,"var":"tags","code":"line = irc_parse_prefix(line, &nick, &address, &tags);","note":"The parser forwards the extracted tags pointer into the message-tag parser when tags are present."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_message_tags","line":434,"var":"split","code":"split = g_strsplit(tags, ';', -1);","note":"The tags string is split into semicolon-delimited fields, so a crafted lone escape remains inside one field."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_message_tags","line":436,"var":"kv","code":"kv = g_strsplit(*tmp, '=', 2);","note":"Each field is split into key and value; a malformed field can leave the value pointer missing or truncated."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":387,"var":"tag","code":"for (; *tmp != '\\0'; tmp++, tag++) { if (*tmp == '\\') { tmp++; switch (*tmp) { ... default: *tag = *tmp; break; } } else { *tag = *tmp; } }","note":"The loop does not stop on a lone trailing backslash escape, so it reads past the end of the tag string and misparses the message tag value."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')),encoding='utf-8')
print(p.read_text())
